dress_code.men: Dhoti and Kanduva, or Kurta-Pyjama. Jeans, T-shirts, and shorts are not permitted in the Kalyanotsavam or Homam halls.
dress_code.women: Saree, Half-Saree, or Salwar-Kameez with Dupatta.

dos: Traditional attire is strictly enforced for sevas (like Kalyanotsavam).
Deposit mobile phones, cameras, laptops, and smartwatches at the hilltop security lockers before entering queue lines.
Park private cars at the foothill multi-level parking lot and use free shuttle buses to go uphill.
Senior citizens and differently-abled pilgrims can use elevators, escalators, wheelchair ramps, and free wheelchair services at hilltop helpdesks.
Wear rubber-soled footwear during monsoons due to slippery stone walkways.
Wear thick socks during summer months (April to June) when stone temperatures exceed 42°C, and visit during early morning or late evening hours.
Report lost children or belongings immediately to the Temple Control Room near the main entrance.
donts: Mobile phones, cameras, laptops, and smartwatches are strictly prohibited inside the main cave temple.
Jeans, T-shirts, and shorts are not permitted in the Kalyanotsavam or Homam halls.
Avoid pushing or jumping barricades in the queue complex.
Overnight stays on the hilltop are highly restricted for the general public.
